face.purpose: Side column, buttons, table headers, still frame, status bar.

ring.purpose: Keyboard focus ring and the mark.

ring-edge.purpose: Dark edge of the focus ring and the mark.

title.purpose: The h1 in the title band.

button-88.purpose: Verdana on the six era buttons only.

shadows.name: sunken
shadows.purpose: Tables, ledger, still frame, status cells. Code wells add inset 1px 1px 0 #404040.

shadows.name: page-edge
shadows.purpose: One-pixel dark outer edge that finishes the page bevel. Not a drop shadow.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on links and 88x31 buttons.

components.name: Title Band
components.description: Teal bar with the name, tagline and yellow stop line.
components.html:
niri-computer-use

Let an agent use your niri desktop. You hold the stop key.
components.css: .ds-band{background:#336666;color:#fff;padding:14px 18px;font-family:Tinos, 'Times New Roman', Times, 'Liberation Serif', serif} .ds-band h1{margin:0;font-size:30px;line-height:1.1} .ds-band p{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:16px} .ds-band strong{color:#ffdd77}

components.name: Side Button
components.description: Bevelled link button that presses in on :active.
components.css: .ds-bevel{display:block;padding:3px 8px;background:#e4e4dc;border:2px solid;border-color:#fff #404040 #404040 #fff;box-shadow:inset -1px -1px 0 #808080;color:#000;font:700 15px/1.45 Tinos, 'Times New Roman', Times, 'Liberation Serif', serif;text-decoration:none;width:140px} .ds-bevel:hover{background:#efefe8} .ds-bevel:active{border-color:#404040 #fff #fff #404040;box-shadow:inset 1px 1px 0 #808080} .ds-bevel:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #0f2626,0 0 0 5px #ffcc33,0 0 0 6px #0f2626;outline:2px solid transparent;}

components.name: Heading Bar
components.description: Light teal bar behind each h2.
components.css: .ds-bar{margin:0;padding:2px 8px;background:#dfe9e9;color:#133333;font:700 19px/1.45 Tinos, 'Times New Roman', Times, 'Liberation Serif', serif;border-top:1px solid #9fbcbc;border-bottom:1px solid #9fbcbc}

components.name: Facts Table
components.description: Sunken table with face-grey row headers.
components.css: .ds-table{width:100%;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:2px;border:1px solid;border-color:#808080 #fff #fff #808080;font:16px/1.45 Tinos, 'Times New Roman', Times, 'Liberation Serif', serif} .ds-table th,.ds-table td{padding:3px 8px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;border:1px solid;border-color:#808080 #fff #fff #808080;} .ds-table th{background:#e4e4dc;font-weight:700;width:108px}

components.name: Notice
components.css: .ds-note{margin:0;padding:4px 10px;background:#ffffcc;border:1px solid #996600;font:700 17px/1.45 Tinos, 'Times New Roman', Times, 'Liberation Serif', serif}

components.name: Safety Ledger
components.description: Two sunken halves: Enforced and Not covered.
components.css: .ds-ledger{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2px;padding:2px;border:1px solid;border-color:#808080 #fff #fff #808080;font-family:Tinos, 'Times New Roman', Times, 'Liberation Serif', serif} .ds-ledger>div{padding:6px 10px 8px;border:1px solid;border-color:#808080 #fff #fff #808080;} .ds-ledger>div+div{background:#fff8ee} .ds-ledger h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:16px} .ds-ledger ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px;font-size:16px}

components.name: 88x31 Button
components.description: Era button in a solid color, presses in on :active.
components.css: .ds-b88{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;width:88px;height:31px;box-sizing:border-box;background:#7a4a00;border:1px solid #000;box-shadow:inset 1px 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.55),inset -1px -1px 0 rgb(0 0 0/.45);color:#fff;font:700 11px/1.05 Verdana,'DejaVu Sans',sans-serif;text-align:center;text-decoration:none} .ds-b88 .s{font-weight:400;font-size:9px;color:#ffe9a8} .ds-b88:hover .t{text-decoration:underline} .ds-b88:active{box-shadow:inset -1px -1px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.55),inset 1px 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0/.45)} .ds-b88:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #0f2626,0 0 0 5px #ffcc33,0 0 0 6px #0f2626;outline:2px solid transparent;}

components.name: Status Bar
components.description: Sunken cells at the foot of the page.
components.html: Best viewed with any browserNo JavaScript
components.css: .ds-status{display:flex;gap:3px;padding:3px;background:#e4e4dc;border-top:1px solid #808080;font:14px/1.45 Tinos, 'Times New Roman', Times, 'Liberation Serif', serif} .ds-status span{flex:1 1 auto;padding:1px 8px;border:1px solid;border-color:#808080 #fff #fff #808080;}

narrative.overview:
A hand-made Linux project page, done with care and not as parody. A 760-pixel white page sits on the desktop grey, with a teal title band on top, a column of bevelled buttons down the side, facts in tables, one framed still that opens a clip, and a sunken status bar at the foot. Everything is set in one serif, Tinos, with system monospace for commands.

The density is that of a document. Facts go in tables and short lists, not sentences. The era shows in the bevels, the link colors, the 88x31 buttons and the status bar, and stops there. The page is light only and has no JavaScript. The Starlight docs pages are a separate system (Archivo, JetBrains Mono, light and dark) and the home page shares none of it.
keyCharacteristics: One 760px page on desk grey, bevelled with a 2px border.
Teal title band with a 24x16 pixel mark and a yellow stop line.
One serif (Tinos 400 and 700), 17px body, monospace only for code.
Raised things are bevelled buttons; sunken things are tables, code wells, the ledger and status cells.
Links are blue, purple when visited, red when pressed.
The focus ring is niri's: amber around a dark edge.
Light only, no JavaScript, a print stylesheet.

rules.name: The Edge Rule
rules.body: Depth comes only from the three bevel colors. Raised is hi top-left, dk bottom-right. Sunken reverses it with lo and hi. No other shadow or edge color is added.

rules.name: The Browser Defaults Rule
rules.body: Link colors are the era's blue, purple and red. Do not restyle them to the teal. Buttons that are links override to ink and keep it when visited.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Everything but code and the 88x31 buttons is Tinos. Do not add a second text face.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: Raised controls press in on :active: side buttons and 88x31 buttons. Nothing animates; there are no transitions.

dos: Do put facts in tables and short lists, not paragraphs.
Do build raised things from hi/dk bevels and sunken things from lo/hi bevels, and press raised controls in on :active.
Do use one still that links to one clip, and state the clip's length, format and size next to the link.
Do keep the page light only, one column on phones, and working without JavaScript.
Do keep a visible focus ring on every link: amber (ring) outside a dark teal edge.
Do keep the print view: address after each outside link, side column and status bar dropped.
Do show only things that are true: version, date, clip size and release rows come from the build, and the "Built on" buttons point at real projects.
Do add era touches with taste: a status bar, bevels, 88x31 buttons for real dependencies. One of each, not a collection.
donts: Don't invent era furniture: no visitor counters, guestbooks, awards, "under construction" signs or webrings.
Don't use gradients, glow, blur, border radius, cards, or soft shadows.
Don't autoplay video or put a play overlay on the still.
Don't add a marketing hero, slogan block or testimonial row.
Don't add a dark mode, JavaScript, animation or transitions to the home page.
Don't use blinking, marquees, tiled backgrounds or the Comic Sans-style parody of the period.
Don't put uppercase labels, kickers or eyebrows over headings.
Don't reuse the docs tokens or fonts on the home page, or the home page's bevels on the docs.
